description: The only tool that searches for a named owner. Fills a person or company name into that county's verified owner/taxpayer field as UPPER(field) LIKE UPPER('%NAME%'), a case-insensitive partial match, and returns a URL you can fetch or open in a browser. get_parcel_endpoint returns the endpoint and a generic sample query, not a name search, so come here for the name. This server does not execute the query and returns no parcel records: fetch the returned URL yourself. Counties that publish no owner name are refused here with that reason.

owner_name.description: Owner/taxpayer name to search for (partial match, case-insensitive)

state.description: Two-letter state abbreviation (e.g. 'IL') or full state name

name: build_owner_query
title: Build an owner-name search URL for one county
